sentences.text: First Information Report is dated 24.07.2019.
Crime is registered on the basis of report lodged by Gopal  Vinayak Mahore, Food Safety Officer of Yavatmal.
Pertinent  to note that name of present applicant is not figuring in the  FIR.

As per FIR, a Bolero pick-up van was intercepted on  Darwha road and when it was searched, it was found that it  was having pan masala, gutkha, etc., which are banned  articles in the State of Maharashtra.

As per the FIR, said driver, on the spot stated that it is his  business and contraband is procured by him for himself to  distribute and sell in the market.

Application for anticipatory bail is being opposed  by learned A.P.P. on the basis of the statement of Shaikh  Jakir Shaikh Gaffar, the arrested accused, in which he  claimed that contraband belongs to present applicant.

When the driver was not arrested that time, he  made a statement that contraband belongs to him, whereas  after his arrest, when he was under the thumb of police  officer and his statement is recorded, he claimed that the  contraband belongs to applicant.
That is the solitary piece of  evidence against the present applicant.

The learned A.P.P., on a pointed query made by  the Court, informed that, after business establishment of the  present applicant was searched, nothing objectionable was  found in his business establishment.
Also, applicant is not  having any past criminal record.
In that view of matter, I pass the following order.
ORDER  (i) The application is allowed.

(ii) In the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.414/2019 registered with Police Station, Digras, Tq. Digras, Dist. Yavatmal for an offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328, of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 26(2) (i),
27(2)(e), 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, applicant-Shripal 3 aba582.19.odt Prakashchandra Bora alias Gotu, be released on bail on he executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
